WGT-014 (Trade Schedule Comparison) is retained with an explicit unavailable-state presentation because both authoritative trade collections supplied for week 54 are empty (construction_trade_count = 0, construction_activity_count = 0). No trade rows, dates, variances or trade names have been inferred, and the widget is not described as a reduced trade selection.

WGT-044 (Progress Photos) is retained with a single authoritative photo record; because the supplied photo_count is 1, the gallery cannot reach the preferred 3-5 image density without fabricating photographs. No substitute or placeholder photographs, captions, trades or locations have been created.

Dense single-sheet composition: the layout uses 20 grid regions with 49 relative row units for one A3 landscape page. Presentation reductions are applied at print level (limited exception rows, selected KPI categories, compact donut legends, shortened axis labels, single photo tile). The renderer must validate physical fit and legibility against the 420 x 297 mm sheet and 12 mm margins; this planning JSON does not assert that physical print fit has been tested.

WGT-009 and WGT-010 share region REG-005 as required and remain analytically distinct panels, preserving weekly planned-versus-actual increments and weekly planned-versus-actual variance respectively, with pp (percentage point) units and no % symbol on increments.

WGT-042 and WGT-043 form the Project Financial Status band as adjacent 6-column regions. Currency is undeclared in the payment package and unavailable in the variation package, so all monetary values are presented without an assumed currency; no unpaid balance, exposure, ratio or total has been derived.

The supplied executive_widgets collection contains two additional widgets outside the approved 19-widget A3 set (WGT-045 Safety Performance KPIs and WGT-048 Authority Approval Status). These are not placed in the layout because only approved widget IDs may be assigned. They are excluded from the composition, not omitted from the mandatory set, and are therefore not listed in omitted_widget_ids.

WGT-002 renders the previous reporting-week planned comparison as 'Not available' using the unavailable token with text, because the baseline planned series is week-ending Sunday and has no observation matching the 24-Sep-2026 reporting cutoff. No interpolation, week-number substitution or zero substitution is applied.

WGT-033 actual manpower gaps for periods with actual_data_available = false must render as gaps or explicit unavailable markers and must not be read as zero manpower; the current W54 period is a partial 2-working-day period and is flagged accordingly.
WGT-026 cumulative distinct submission counts are preserved as supplied; weekly increments are not derived from them, and flat W53-to-W54 segments are source-reported unchanged cumulative totals.

WGT-039 and WGT-040 display a declared selected subset of the 11 supplied KPIs. No KPI-level unit is supplied in either calculation package, so no cross-KPI aggregation, total or normalisation is performed, and confirmed zeros are preserved distinctly from unavailable quantities.

All print-interactive elements (navigation, filters, selectors, tooltips, sort icons, pagination, export and loading states) are suppressed; all substantive values, legends, status labels and data qualifications from the supplied Widget ASTs are preserved.
